title: 第27章 敢动我果盘？
novel_title: 县城：女友出国要我卖房，给脸了
content_zh:
娱乐场所本就鱼龙混杂，喝酒闹事经常发生。

    不过。

    白宫会所这种高端娱乐场所，基本上客人与客人之间极少会发生冲突摩擦，一般都是与会所方面发生争执。

    李西雄出去上个厕所就被围了。

    看样子还不是会所方面，是跟其他人。

    这就奇怪了。

    李西英五大三粗，李西海也是气势汹汹。

    他们身后都跟着各自点的果盘。

    阿知听了李西海的话，但没有留在包间，告诉李西朋的人等着后，就跟着出来了。

    身为有客人的公主，果盘是要随时随地跟着的。

    不管是上厕所，还是去什么地方。

    比如李西雄没在包厢上，在外面的厕所，他的果盘就跟着一起，在厕所外守着。

    拐了个角，就看到厕所门口，堵了不少人。

    会所的安保在中间劝说着。

    但对方人多势众，不断推搡。

    李西雄有果盘小心的拉着。

    他在大喊大叫，道：“你算尼玛个勾八。”

    “要是在江云，劳资现在让你起不来。”

    “装尼玛，你个小比。”

    “跟老子跳，还要抢老子的人？”

    李西英强势插入，本就魁梧的身材，带来极大的压迫力，喝了酒之后，他情绪也控制不住，直接指着对面一群人，“怎么滴，人多势众是不是？”

    李西海也站到李西雄身后。

    “西海。”

    “哥，怎么回事？”

    “这个小比，我厕所上完出来，就看到他对我果盘拉拉扯扯的。”

    李西雄说了大概情况。

    果盘在厕所外守着，不知道怎么的就被一个喝醉的年轻人骚扰。

    这还得了？

    劳资付了钱点的人，这时间就是他的人。

    被这么骚扰就是打脸。

    李西雄都没找会所的人，直接就刚起来。

    对方还叫嚣，多少钱把果盘让给他。

    “哥，是我的错。”

    88号果盘低声说道：“之前他点过我。”

    “我也不知道他会这样。”

    李西雄骂道：“特么的一点规矩都不懂。”

    “你跳尼玛呢。”

    “小杂种。”

    那小年轻也是对骂道：“你说什么？”

    “你他么再骂。”

    “……”

    双方指着对方都在火力全开，互相对骂，会所安保站在中间，竭力阻拦双方的肢体冲突。

    骂可以。
content_en:
Entertainment venues are already a mixed bag, and drinking and trouble often occur.

    but.

    In a high-end entertainment venue like the White House Club, there are basically very few conflicts and frictions between guests. They usually have disputes with the club.

    Li Xixiong was surrounded when he went out to use the toilet.

    It seems that it's not with the club, but with other people.

    This is strange.

    Li Xiying is powerful and strong, and Li Xihai is also aggressive.

    Behind them were the fruit plates they ordered.

    A Zhi listened to Li Xihai's words, but did not stay in the private room. After telling Li Xipeng's people to wait, he followed him out.

    As a princess with guests, the fruit plate must be followed at all times.

    Whether it’s going to the bathroom or going somewhere.

    For example, Li Xixiong was not in the box but in the toilet outside. His fruit plate was also guarded outside the toilet.

    Turning the corner, I saw a lot of people blocking the toilet door.

    The security guard of the club persuaded in the middle.

    But the other party was outnumbered and kept pushing and shoving.

    Li Xixiong carefully pulled the fruit plate.

    He was yelling, "You're a fool."

    "If you were in Jiangyun, labor and management would prevent you from getting up now."

    "Fake it, you little bitch."

    "Dance with me, but also steal my people?"

    Li Xiying penetrated forcefully, and his burly figure brought great pressure. After drinking, he couldn't control his emotions and pointed directly at the group of people opposite, "What? There is strength in numbers, right?"

    Li Xihai also stood behind Li Xixiong.

    "Western Sea."

    "Brother, what's going on?"

    "This little Bi, when I came out of the toilet, I saw him pulling on my fruit plate."

    Li Xixiong gave an overview of the situation.

    Guopan was guarding outside the toilet and was harassed by a drunk young man for some reason.

    Is this okay?

    For those who have paid their dues, this time is theirs.

    Being harassed like this is a slap in the face.

    Li Xixiong didn't even look for anyone in the club, he just got up directly.

    The other party also yelled how much it would cost to give him the fruit plate.

    "Brother, it's my fault."

    Fruit Plate No. 88 whispered: "He ordered me before."

    "I didn't know he would be like this."

    Li Xixiong scolded: "You don't understand any of the fucking rules."

    "You are dancing."

    "Little bastard."

    The young man also scolded him: "What did you say?"

    "Why don't you scold me again."

    "..."

    Both parties were pointing at each other and hurling insults at each other, while club security stood in the middle and tried their best to prevent the physical conflict between the two parties.

    It’s okay to scold.
title_en: Chapter 27 Dare to touch my fruit plate?
